entities.name: PMID:27510602
observations: 2017 Lupus clinical study: 37 women with SLE received atorvastatin 20 mg/day for 8 weeks; carotid-femoral PWV followed after treatment and withdrawal, without a parallel control group.

entities.name: Atorvastatin
observations: Administered at 20 mg/day for 8 weeks in the SLE study PMID:27510602.

entities.name: Atorvastatin PWV response
observations: In SLE patients with pathological baseline stiffness, carotid-femoral PWV fell from 8.43 ± 1.45 to 7.42 ± 1.06 m/s after 8 weeks of atorvastatin (P=0.002), and improvement persisted 6 months after withdrawal; uncontrolled before–after evidence.
Middle-aged subgroup PWV fell from 7.16 ± 1.23 to 6.76 ± 0.82 m/s (about 0.40 m/s; P=0.05), a borderline finding.
